source_title: Weaviate Shared Cloud is now generally available on AWS
claim_summary: Vendor announces Weaviate Shared Cloud GA on AWS in US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Frankfurt), in addition to GCP; lists Query Agent, Weaviate Embeddings, Data Import Tool and Data Explorer and says Engram and Model Evaluation are coming
feature: managed hosting on a second cloud provider
limitation: Vendor announcement only; no account created and nothing provisioned; SOC 2/ISO 27001 claims not checked

source_title: v1.37.0 - Secure MCP Server, Extensible tokenizers, Incremental backups, ...
claim_summary: Minor release adds a built-in MCP server (Preview; disabled by default; MCP_SERVER_ENABLED) exposing schema, tenant, hybrid-search and optional upsert tools, extensible tokenizers phase 1 (accent folding, stopword presets), file-based incremental backups, collection export (Preview), drop vector index (Experimental) and a BlobHash property type; Breaking Changes listed as none
feature: built-in MCP server for agents; tokenizer and backup features
availability: MCP server, collection export: preview; drop vector index: experimental
limitation: Release notes are vendor-authored; not executed. Vendor blog (2026-04-23) describes the same release; the deprecated standalone mcp-server-weaviate README says the built-in server is available 'from v1.37.1 onward' (conflicts with v1.37.0 notes)

source_title: Engram deep dive
claim_summary: Vendor describes Engram, a managed memory service running on top of Weaviate for agents (pipelines, topics, scopes, buffers) and invites users to get started in Weaviate Cloud
availability: pre-GA availability in Weaviate Cloud (GA announced 2026-06-03)
limitation: Architecture claims vendor-only; hosted proprietary service; no source code for the service found

source_title: v6.0.0-alpha.1
claim_summary: First alpha of a rewritten Go client v6: new API contracts, data/collections/backups APIs, API-key and OIDC auth, ORM and hybrid search
limitation: Pre-release; breaking API relative to v5 implied by the major version, migration effort not measured; v5.7.3 maintenance release followed on 2026-06-30

claim_summary: Python client 4.21.0 adds support for Weaviate 1.37 features; PyPI first upload 2026-04-23T10:37Z
availability: released on PyPI; BSD 3-clause per PyPI metadata
limitation: GitHub release object is dated 2026-04-28T13:36Z while PyPI upload is 2026-04-23 (date conflict recorded; PyPI date used); notes are one line

source_title: Weaviate Release Notes (28 April 2026 entry)
claim_summary: DigitalOcean states its Vector Databases offering is GA in Data Services and includes Weaviate in private preview for opted-in customers (preview clusters not billed), alongside OpenSearch and PostgreSQL/pgvector
limitation: Second-entity documentary record, not a usage measure; Weaviate-side announcement not found in the in-window blog index; page dateModified 2026-07-01

source_title: v1.35.21 - New text2vec-digitalocean module
claim_summary: Patch release adds a new text2vec-digitalocean vectorizer module (also in v1.36.15 on 2026-05-22); a generative-digitalocean module followed in v1.39.2/v1.38.13/v1.37.15 (2026-08-26..27)
limitation: Module added in patch releases across three maintained minor lines; not executed

source_title: Build a Coding Assistant with Weaviate MCP: RAG over Code & Docs
claim_summary: Vendor tutorial shows ingesting a codebase (FastAPI demo) and its docs into Weaviate and connecting Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code to the built-in /v1/mcp endpoint for hybrid code/doc retrieval
feature: code and documentation retrieval for coding agents
limitation: Single-author anecdote (>80K tokens in three turns) is not a measurement; no accepted-task outcome; page includes an 'Agent runbook: autonomous setup' section of scripts addressed to agents that was not executed

source_title: Weaviate MCP server README (deprecation notice)
claim_summary: Standalone Weaviate MCP server repository marked deprecated and redirected to the MCP server built into the weaviate/weaviate binary (deprecation commit 2026-05-25, merged 2026-05-26)
feature: consolidation of MCP server into the database
limitation: Repository shows no detected license via GitHub API (2026-10-16); downstream users of the standalone server must migrate

source_title: Leveling up Weaviate Cloud security: Expanding role-based access control for Cloud console
claim_summary: Vendor adds Editor and Viewer roles to existing Owner and Admin roles for Weaviate Cloud organizations
limitation: Cloud console only; not tested; separate from database-level RBAC

source_title: Engram is now Generally Available
claim_summary: Vendor declares Engram GA in Weaviate Cloud with a free tier; personalization templates at launch, continual-learning and multi-agent templates promised 'in the following weeks'
feature: managed agent memory with scopes and async pipelines
limitation: Durability and reconciliation claims unverified; service sends agent events to a hosted service (data-handling terms not read)

source_title: v1.38.0 - HFresh, Namespaces, Nested Object Filtering, Alter Schema Reindex property
claim_summary: Minor release: HFresh disk-based vector index GA, Namespaces (Preview), Nested Object Filtering (Preview), Alter Schema reindex (Preview), Boost API, production-ready replica movement; MCP section still headed 'Secure MCP Server (Preview)'; includes PR 11493 restricting role assignment to roles the caller holds
feature: disk-based index GA; multi-tenant namespaces; RBAC fix
limitation: Breaking Changes listed as none; the RBAC fix was not labelled as a security fix in the notes (CVE-2026-59093 assigned by a third party on 2026-07-02)

source_title: Weaviate has an Improper Authorization issue (CVE-2026-11500)
claim_summary: Advisory: improper authorization in validateConfig of the static API key handler in Weaviate up to 1.37.7; remote, high complexity; fixed in 1.38.0-rc.0; GHSA severity low; CNA VulDB scores CVSS 3.1 5.0 and CVSS 4.0 1.3
limitation: CNA is VulDB, not the vendor; NVD status Deferred; no vendor security post found; exploit availability claim not verified

source_title: Verba README: Project Discontinued - Repository Archived
claim_summary: Weaviate's BSD-3-Clause Verba RAG application was archived (final commit 'goodbye' 2026-06-08); README states no further updates, bug fixes or security patches
feature: end of maintenance for a reusable OSS app
limitation: Archive date inferred from last push/commit; a later third-party CVE (2026-10-04) affects Verba up to 2.1.3 and will not be patched by the vendor

source_title: Weaviate Cloud is now free to start
claim_summary: CEO post: Weaviate Cloud database, Query Agent and Engram all have free tiers without credit card or time expiration; claims 'many millions of active Weaviate databases' monthly and client downloads 'rapidly approaching double-digit millions'
availability: vendor-stated available; allowances on pricing page
limitation: Usage and download figures are unaudited vendor statements and are not adoption evidence; allowances not checked

source_title: v1.36.18 - Introduce rate limiter in batch simple logic, Disable debug endpoints by default
claim_summary: Patch release disables debug endpoints by default and adds a batch rate limiter for modules
feature: secure-by-default change in a patch release
limitation: Breaking Changes listed as none although a default changed; which other minor lines received the debug-endpoint default not confirmed

source_title: v1.37.10 - HFresh vector index Fixes, ..., Module X-*-BaseURL request headers validation Fix, New generative-deepseek module
claim_summary: Patch release validates X-*-BaseURL request headers in modules 'to close SSRF bypass' and adds a generative-deepseek module; same fix titled in v1.36.19 (2026-06-24) and v1.38.2 (2026-06-25)
limitation: No advisory or CVE found for this fix; the 2026-10-01 vendor post says this base-URL validation did not cover the Google modules' apiEndpoint field

source_title: Weaviate 1.38 Release
claim_summary: Vendor release post states HFresh and the built-in MCP Server reach general availability in 1.38, async replication runs by default on replicated collections, and MCP enable flags become runtime-configurable
limitation: Conflicts with the GitHub v1.38.0 release notes, which head the MCP section 'Secure MCP Server (Preview)'; conflict not resolved

source_title: Weaviate Release Notes (1 July 2026 entry)
claim_summary: DigitalOcean states Managed Weaviate is in public preview and enabled for all users, creatable via control panel, /v2/vector-databases API or doctl (a 28 May entry added control-panel create/resize/restore in private preview)
limitation: Second-entity documentary record; preview legal terms not read; not a usage measure

source_title: Weaviate < 1.38.0 - Privilege Escalation via Unchecked Permissions in RBAC Role Assignment
claim_summary: CVE-2026-59093: before 1.38.0 a user holding only assign_and_revoke_users/groups could assign the built-in admin role to itself or others; CVSS 3.1 8.8 and CVSS 4.0 8.7 (VulnCheck); fix PR 11493 merged 2026-05-28 and shipped in v1.38.0
limitation: CNA is VulnCheck; GitHub advisory GHSA-667j-56pf-pq9c is unreviewed with no affected ranges; no vendor security post found

source_title: v3.14.0 - Boost, Diversity Selection
claim_summary: TypeScript client adds Boost parameter to all query types and diversity selection for near-queries; npm publish 2026-07-17T11:03Z
feature: client support for Boost and MMR
limitation: Vendor notes only; not executed

source_title: v1.38.7 - Never use a search result as a read-repair payload
claim_summary: Patch releases on two minor lines titled 'Never use a search result as a read-repair payload' (replication data-integrity fix) plus fixes for empty range results after reindex
limitation: Impact and affected data not described; no advisory; title-level evidence only

source_title: v1.39.0 - Namespaces, RQ4, Hybrid MMR, Alter Schema, gRPC web, Search REST API
claim_summary: Minor release: Namespaces (control-plane and data isolation), BM25/BlockMax rework, Alter Schema reindex and drop-index (Preview), gRPC-web endpoint, dedicated Search REST API, Hybrid MMR, 4-bit Rotational Quantization, Boost API; Breaking Changes listed as none
limitation: Vendor blog (2026-08-27) labels Boost and MMR GA, RQ4 preview and the Search REST API experimental; GitHub notes do not carry those labels for every item

source_title: Scaling Test-Time Compute in Search Mode
claim_summary: Vendor adds an effort parameter (medium/high/ultrahigh) to Query Agent Search Mode in weaviate-agents 1.8.0 (PyPI 2026-08-11T13:46Z) and reports nDCG@10 57.5 at ultrahigh vs 13.0 for hybrid search on BRIGHT Biology
availability: released in Python SDK; hosted Query Agent service
limitation: Benchmark is vendor-run on one subset, no cost/latency denominator verified; agents-typescript-client 1.7.0 not checked; weaviate-agents PyPI metadata carries no license field (GitHub repo is BSD-3-Clause)

source_title: add Weaviate license and license switch
claim_summary: Commit adds LICENSE-BSD and wl/LICENSE-WEAVIATE and rewrites LICENSE: code outside wl/ stays BSD-3-Clause, code inside wl/ is under a separate Weaviate License, initially toggled by a WEAVIATE_LICENSE environment variable; first release tag carrying wl/LICENSE-WEAVIATE is v1.39.4 (2026-09-11)
availability: on main; in tags from v1.39.4
limitation: Licence change observed in repository files, not legal review; GitHub API reports repository license as NOASSERTION (2026-10-16); no vendor blog announcement found in window

source_title: v1.39.3 - Aggregate performance improvements, Modules and GraphQL security Fixes, New generative-meta module
claim_summary: Patch release (also v1.38.14, v1.37.16) titled 'Modules and GraphQL security Fixes'; the vendor's 2026-10-01 post says v1.39.3 fixes a high-severity Google-module credential disclosure; notes also list a nearObject beacon consistency fix
limitation: Release notes do not describe the vulnerability; disclosure came 24 days later; a second fix in v1.39.3 (nearObject) was disclosed on 2026-10-15, outside the window

product: HFresh index on Weaviate Cloud free tier
source_title: HFresh: Memory-Efficient Vector Search
claim_summary: Vendor explains HFresh disk-based index tradeoffs and states the Weaviate Cloud Free Tier uses HFresh by default through its Cost Optimized profile
feature: default index choice on free tier
limitation: Default not verified in a cluster; performance figures in the post not checked

claim_summary: New MIT-licensed Go CLI (repo created 2026-09-11) described as 'agent-first provisioning' for Weaviate Cloud; every result-returning command emits a JSON envelope intended for coding agents; README states Beta (v0.1) with the envelope and error codes as the stable part
limitation: Not installed or executed; v0.1.2 published 2026-10-13 (outside window)

source_title: Replace WEAVIATE_LICENSE env toggle with LICENSE_KEY form check
claim_summary: Commit removes the WEAVIATE_LICENSE boolean and enables Weaviate-licensed functionality only with a well-formed LICENSE_KEY (wv8.<license_id>.<ed25519 seed>); the check validates form only and makes no network requests
limitation: Commit message is vendor text; key format and offline behaviour not executed

source_title: 4-bit Rotational Quantization
claim_summary: Vendor states 1.39 adds 4-bit Rotational Quantization with similar recall and a 45% heap reduction, and that 8-bit RQ is significantly faster; compares with TurboQuant
limitation: Vendor benchmark; heap reduction is not an energy measure

source_title: Weaviate review
claim_summary: Third-party review describes Weaviate licensing as split: BSD-3-Clause core and a proprietary Weaviate License for features in wl/ that activate only with a paid license key, and notes GitHub reports the license as 'Other'
limitation: Publisher reputation not assessed; partly matches repository files; the same page's other claims were not checked

source_title: Update wl license text per legal
claim_summary: LICENSE and wl/LICENSE-WEAVIATE now state that wl/ code is 'Copyright Weaviate BV 2026-present, all rights reserved' and only available under a separate enterprise license enabled via license key; LICENSE-BSD unchanged
availability: on main; in v1.39.12 and v1.40.0 tags
limitation: The enterprise-edition link in the licence text returned HTTP 404 when fetched on 2026-10-16; full enterprise terms not available to read

source_title: Weaviate security release - High severity fix for credential disclosure in the Google modules
claim_summary: Vendor discloses that an unvalidated apiEndpoint in text2vec-google, multi2vec-google and generative-google could send the operator's Google credential (API key or cloud-platform OAuth token) to an arbitrary host, including via a read-only GraphQL query parameter; CVSS High (7.1); affects < v1.39.3; CVE pending; Cloud and Marketplace customers patched; no indication of exploitation
limitation: Vendor self-report; CVE not yet assigned in the post; no GitHub advisory found for it via gh api on 2026-10-16; reported by an independent researcher via the vendor VDP

source_title: v6.0.0-rc.0 - Config API, HNSW, Array properties, ...
claim_summary: First release candidate of Go client v6 adds config APIs, vector index types, array properties and OpenAI/Google/Hugging Face vectorizers; uses gRPC stubs from the upstream Weaviate package
limitation: Pre-release; v6 GA not observed in window

source_title: CVE-2026-105145: Weaviate Verba information disclosure
claim_summary: Advisory (CNA VulDB): information disclosure via get_environment in the generate_stream endpoint of Weaviate Verba up to 2.1.3; remote; public exploit; CVSS 3.1 5.3; VulDB says the vendor was contacted early but did not respond
feature: vulnerability in an archived OSS app
limitation: GHSA is unreviewed with no affected ranges; non-response claim is VulDB's statement and was not verified

source_title: v1.40.0 - Alter Schema Drop Vector Index, HFresh MUVERA, RQ-4 quantization
claim_summary: Minor release: Namespaces (GA), drop vector index (GA), HFresh MUVERA, deduplicated backups, Search REST API, RQ4; notes include 'Make namespaces a feature requiring license' and 'Gate deduplicated backups on a Weaviate license key'; wl/ now contains namespaces, backupdedupe and selfrecovery; Breaking Changes listed as none
availability: released; some features require a Weaviate licence key
limitation: Gating behaviour not executed; whether self-hosted users of Namespaces from 1.38/1.39 lose access on upgrade is not stated; 'Breaking Changes: none' sits beside licence gating

source_title: Persistent memory for Claude Code with Weaviate Engram
claim_summary: Vendor releases a Claude Code plugin that searches Engram before each answer and saves each exchange (user message and reply) to Engram afterwards, giving cross-repository and optionally team-shared memory; Engram free up to 1,000 runs per month
feature: cross-session memory for a coding agent
limitation: Plugin uploads prompt and reply text to a hosted service; weaviate/engram-plugins repository (created 2026-07-01) shows no detected license via GitHub API; not installed or executed
